findings.text: Qualifying targets in the schema does not let the current exporter load the recommended test selection, because it imports all selected modules into one environment and both `SqlFileForms` and `SqlFileErrors` define `shop`. Fix: require extraction in each module’s own import environment before combining the rows.

The smallest containing range does not identify one user for the containerless `DecidableEq` mention in `deriving instance DecidableEq for ConflictAction, ConflictClause`, because both instances have that exact range. Fix: use the range fallback only for a unique innermost declaration and record an empty user on a tie so the query cannot count an arbitrary sole user.

Comparing the compiled SQL source record with disk cannot establish the promised file identity, because `sqlTextHash` gives CRLF and LF text the same hash. Fix: define SQL freshness using the existing line-ending normalization in both the specification and ADR D2, or require a byte-preserving freshness check.

Rule 3 says every instance of a command shares one range, but `deriving instance Lean.FromJson, Lean.ToJson for Comparison, ArithmeticOperator` gives the `FromJson` and `ToJson` instances distinct class-token ranges. Fix: group instances and helpers by the range of each class within the command and use the whole command only for stored text.

The prefix and reference rules select different parents for `instToExprExpr_1.toExpr_2`, whose name has the `instToExprExpr_1` prefix but whose direct caller is `instToExprArguments`. Fix: fold a helper only when the rules identify one parent and report conflicting candidates.

Dropping outgoing relationships from cross-module helpers contradicts ADR D6’s requirement to fold both ends and loses recorded edges such as the `type` reference from `Database.run.eq_1` to `Sql.run`. Fix: retain the file that contributed the edge and identify the folded user by its parent’s module and name.
